# dist/ — GENERATED OUTPUT

> **Do not edit files in this folder manually.**

This folder contains the generated Fabric / Power BI artefacts:

- **`<Domain>.SemanticModel/`** — TMDL semantic models (measures, tables, relationships)
- **`<ID>_<Name>.Report/`** — PBIR reports (pages, visuals, themes)

All content here is regenerated by:

```powershell
.\products\fabric\powerbi\orchestrator\orchestrate_full_model.ps1
```

---

## Local gold path (`GoldDataPath`)

The five semantic models read the Aurora gold layer through the Power Query parameter
`GoldDataPath` (`<Domain>.SemanticModel/definition/expressions.tmdl`). In Git it holds the
placeholder `<GOLD_DATA_PATH>`, never a path of one machine: `Folder.Files` needs an absolute
path, and an absolute path under `C:/Users/<name>/` names a person and fits no other machine.
`tooling/codegen/gold_source.py` writes the placeholder, and
`tooling/tests/test_dist_heimpfade.py` fails on any personal home path in `dist/`.

To load data locally:

1. Open `dist.pbip` (or the report's `.pbip`) in Power BI Desktop.
2. **Home → Transform data → Edit parameters** (or in Power Query: *Manage Parameters*).
3. Set `GoldDataPath` to the absolute path of `showcases/aurora_group/data/gold` in your
   checkout, with forward slashes and no trailing slash, e.g.
   `D:/src/analytics-usecase-library/showcases/aurora_group/data/gold`.
4. **Apply changes** and refresh.

Do not save that value back into Git: the Desktop edit changes `expressions.tmdl`. Revert the
line before committing (`git checkout -p` on that file) or run
`python -m tooling.codegen.gold_source --write`, which restores the placeholder. Reading from
OneLake instead of a local folder goes through the parameters `GoldSourceKind` and
`GoldContainerUrl`; that path is not yet verified in a tenant run (docstring of
`tooling/codegen/gold_source.py`).

---

## Why this exists

`dist/` is the output of the source layer (`core/`, `blueprints/`, `orchestrator/`, `tooling/`).
Keeping it in Git gives you versioned snapshots and enables diff-based validation in CI.

## Where source lives

| What | Source location |
|---|---|
| KPI definitions / measure logic | `core/kpi_catalog/` |
| Action logic | `core/action_codes/` |
| Data contracts (Silver layer) | `core/data_contracts/` |
| Domain blueprints | `products/fabric/powerbi/blueprints/` |
| Generation scripts | `products/fabric/powerbi/orchestrator/` |
| Tooling / validators | `products/fabric/powerbi/tooling/` |

To add a new measure or modify KPIs, edit the source above and re-run the orchestrator.
